mapper.select: SELECT n.noti_id AS notice_id, n.title AS notice_title, n.content AS notice_content, n.priority AS notice_type, n.sender_id AS create_by, u.real_name AS create_by_name, n.status, n.publish_time, n.create_time, n.update_time, NULL AS remark FROM my_notification n LEFT JOIN my_sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.sender_id WHERE n.status = 1 AND n.sender_type = 2 /* 教师端:只看教师(sender_type=2)发的通知,过滤系统/管理员 */ ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC, n.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.noti_id AS notice_id, n.title AS notice_title, n.content AS notice_content, n.priority AS notice_type, n.sender_id AS create_by, u.real_name AS create_by_name, n.status, n.publish_time, n.create_time, n.update_time, NULL AS remark FROM my_notification n LEFT JOIN my_sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.sender_id WHERE n.status = 1 AND n.sender_type = 2 /* 教师端:只看教师发的 */ AND n.priority = #{noticeType} ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC, n.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
